name: panelalpha-tine-frontend-build
description: Not tine's package.json. It exists so the engine's host frontend pass has something to run: HostCompile::runForPhp() reads package.json in the checkout root and needs a `build` script in it, and tine's own package.json is four levels down in tine20/Tinebase/js. No dependencies: `npm install` here installs nothing and panelalpha-build.sh does the real install where the real manifest is.

scripts.prebuild: git config --global --add safe.directory '*'; git submodule update --init --recursive --depth 1 || true
